title: FsStore: RUNBOOK section not written
description: stoa-d6da944c committed to 'RUNBOOK section: directory layout, disk sizing, GC note' but nothing was written. An operator setting up the filesystem backend has no guidance on: how many bytes per block to expect for sizing, what the directory will look like (one .block file per CID, named base32), how to run manual GC (find ... -mtime +N -delete), or what happens to in-flight .block.tmp files if the daemon crashes. This needs to be in docs/ or in a comment block in the config.
